ALPACA_SECRET_KEY: Alpaca API secret key; pair with ALPACA_API_KEY. Never commit real values.
ALPACA_BASE_URL: Alpaca REST API base URL. Use https://paper-api.alpaca.markets/v2 for paper trading.
UNIVERSE_SOURCE: How the tradable universe is built (e.g. file reads UNIVERSE_FILE; other modes if configured).
UNIVERSE_FILE: Path to the universe list file when UNIVERSE_SOURCE=file (relative to project root unless absolute).
STARTING_CAPITAL: Starting portfolio value in dollars for backtests, training envs, and sizing context in paper/live.
LIVE_PPO_MODEL_PATH: Filesystem path to the PPO meta-learner checkpoint used when running live Alpaca trading.
